title: Imperial Scored Nothing
description: In game 8261fb3f the Xxcha played Imperial in round 5 with Push Boundaries (ahead of 3 of 3 neighbours) and Unify the Colonies (6 hazardous planets) met, but Letnev had landed on Archon Ren nine minutes earlier. Rule 61.16 bars every public objective while a home planet is lost, so the engine asked nothing and only the Mecatol Rex point followed; the UI still showed both objectives as a pulsing 'Ready'. Now the Objectives dialog says why (banner, 'Met · home system lost') and playing Imperial with nothing scoreable shows a corner notice. Mocked fixtures; regenerate with npm run screenshots -- CV.

notes.title: Root cause (not an engine bug)
notes.text: Replaying the game's 1382 decisions on the current engine: Xxcha controls 14 planets but Archon Ren is Letnev's (landed 05:26:24, Imperial played 05:35:08). counting/position progress: unify_colonies 6/6, push_boundaries 3/2 (14 vs Sol 12, Hacan 4, Letnev 11). controls_home_system = false, so objectives::scoreable_on returns [] (61.16) and imperial_primary skips the scoring question; Xxcha holds Mecatol Rex, so it gained the 1 VP (7 to 8).

notes.title: Data
notes.text: The server now sends table.home_system_lost: per seat, the home planets it does not control, only for seats that therefore cannot score (engine objectives::home_planets_not_controlled, the same test as controls_home_system, so Saar's Nomadic is honoured). Display only: no rule changed; planet control is public.

notes.title: When the notice shows
notes.text: Only for the viewer's own Imperial, and only when it is certain from the view: a lost home planet, or every unscored revealed objective has progress and none is met. While the viewer is being asked which objective to score, nothing is shown.
